_comment: Tile Palette — reusable tile types used to paint maps. Each tile carries a string `id` (the identity that map.grid cells reference), display `name`, `walkable` flag, and `sprite` reference into the /sprites/map/ library. Optional `flags` carry lighting metadata. Optional `link` is a one-way portal — when the party steps on a cell painted with this tile, they teleport to the destination: `{ "map_id": "<target-map>", "x": <col>, "y": <row> }`. Links are one-way, so the return trip needs a complementary tile on the destination map. To have visually-identical tiles with different destinations (e.g., two doors going to different rooms), create separate tile entries — that's the v1 pattern that worked. Trimmed down from the v1 legacy catalog to a basic outdoor + interior starter set; add more via the editor as needed.
